Alternative Qd3: quiet queen move to d3, parries a threat (~3).

White can win material now: Qxb6 wins ~1 (takes pawn)
Black threatens (if it were their move): Rxe3 wins ~4 (takes queen); Qxe5 wins ~1 (takes pawn); Rxe5 wins ~1 (takes pawn)

Idea: Answer the threat to the queen by grabbing the king's shelter pawn.
Assessment: White is winning because Black's king on c8 has lost its pawn shield and is exposed to the queen and rooks.
Why Qxb6: Re4 attacks the queen. 1.Qxb6 escapes with tempo and rips open the c8 king. After 1...Qxe5 2.Rb2 the b-file is open, Qb8 mate is threatened, and Black must give back material.
Why not Qd3: Qd3 only retreats. Black gets time for ...b5 and ...d5, doubles rooks on open files, and White's attacking chances disappear.
Concepts: king_safety, mating_attack, initiative
Plan: Bring a rook to the b-file and hunt the exposed king.
